source_pr_title: hooks: mutations through bro subcommands cite their governing skill (bro-d8s)
author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**WARNING:** `bro debt next --claim` mutates the ledger but cites no skill

The `debt` verb table covers collect/mark/set/sync, but `cmdNext --claim` performs a real state change: it CAS-claims the top finding and rewrites the summary (packages/cli/src/commands/debt.ts:784-798). So `bro debt next --claim` mutates without emitting the governing-skill hint — and since `classifyArmCommand` arms `task` only for `bd … --claim`, it neither arms a gate nor cites a skill. Mirror the `act wait` pattern: treat `debt next` as a mutation only when `--claim` is present in `rest`, so a bare `bro debt next` read stays silent.

author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**SUGGESTION:** the once-per-session dedup is check-then-write, not atomic

`skillHinted` + `markSkillHinted` is a TOCTOU pair: parallel tool calls in the same session can both observe no marker and both emit the hint (concurrent post-tool hooks are an anticipated case — see the `markerPath` comment above). An exclusive create collapses the race: attempt `writeFileSync(path, ts, { flag: 'wx' })` first and treat `EEXIST` as already-hinted (falling back to the mtime/TTL check), so first-create-wins dedups without a lock.
